terbaru.judul: Inverse Design of Compact and Wideband Inverted Doherty Power Amplifiers Using Deep Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper presents a deep learning-assisted methodology for the inverse synthesis of a compact, wideband inverted Doherty power amplifier (PA).

terbaru.judul: RunSoC 2.0: Scheduling and Allocating Automotive Software Tasks to Hardware Partitions in Heterogeneous MPSoCs
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper presents RunSoC 2.0, a customizable framework for early-stage design-space exploration of task scheduling and allocation on heterogeneous MPSoCs.

terbaru.judul: Latency-Aware Service Placement using Neural Combinatorial Optimisers for Edge--Cloud Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: This study proposes a latency-aware Edge Placement Neural Combinatorial Optimiser (EP-NCO), a learning-based framework for service placement in compute continuum platforms.

terbaru.judul: An Agnostic Machine Learning Model of Photosynthetic Habitability
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce an agnostic PHZ derived from a generalized model of photosynthesis grounded in thermodynamics and redox chemistry, without reference to model organisms.

terbaru.judul: EchoFlow: A Workload-Aware Parameter Tuning Method for Blockchain Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this, we propose EchoFlow, a blockchain parameter tuning framework that adaptively adjusts parameter configurations based on workload characteristics, enabling continuous performance optimization.

terbaru.judul: Fabrication Of Bilayer Nanofibers From Poly Xylitol Dodecanedioic Acid, Poly Caprolactone, Gelatin Biological Macromolecules And Surface Modification Via Spin Coating Of Capsules For Skin Wound Treatment
terbaru.pelajaran: In this study, poly xylitol dodecanedioic acid was synthesized from xylitol and dodecanedioic acid monomers in a 1:1 molar ratio with Mw = 4038 g/mol using the polycondensation method.

terbaru.judul: RoverDevKit: An open, physics-grounded tradespace toolkit for conceptual design of lunar micro-rovers
terbaru.pelajaran: We present RoverDevKit, a tradespace exploration toolkit with an open evaluator that couples a closed-form wheel-soil model with bottom-up mass, solar-power, thermal-survival, and traverse models.

terbaru.judul: Accelerating Simulation and Optimisation of Cyclic Adsorption Processes with Differentiable Programming
terbaru.pelajaran: This work presents an end-to-end differentiable model of a pressure vacuum swing adsorption process, developed using the JAX differentiable programming framework and applied here to a benchmark post-combustion carbon capture problem.

terbaru.judul: MBRarefy: data-adaptive multi-bin rarefying for alpha diversity association analysis
terbaru.pelajaran: Summary: This paper presents MBRarefy, an R package that provides a reproducible workflow for alpha diversity analysis under confounding from heterogeneous library sizes.
